headline: Executive order changes earlier tariffs on goods from China that were tied to concerns about the synthetic opioid supply chain.
what_it_does: This order amends an earlier executive order that placed extra duties (import taxes) on goods from China, which was linked to the flow of synthetic opioids such as fentanyl. The title alone does not say what the specific changes are. More detail would be needed to explain exactly how the duties were adjusted.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that import goods from China
who_it_affects.how: The rules for duties they pay on Chinese goods may change under this amendment.

who_it_affects.group: Shoppers who buy products made in China
who_it_affects.how: Changes to import duties can affect the prices or delivery of goods they buy.
